/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.name: external-dns
/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.doc: ExternalDNS is a Kubernetes add-on that automatically manages the creation and updates of DNS records for services running in your cluster. It integrates with a variety of DNS providers, such as CloudFlare DNS, Amazon Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, and more, to ensure that your applications are easily accessible from anywhere with a DNS name. With ExternalDNS, you can simplify the process of managing DNS records for your home lab, eliminating the need for manual updates and reducing the risk of errors.

apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: traefik-gateway
      namespace: traefik
      sectionName: websecure
      kind: Gateway

  hostnames:
    - {{ .Release.Name }}.${main_domain}

  rules:
    - matches:
      - path:
          type: PathPrefix
          value: /

      backendRefs:
      - name: {{ .Release.Name }}
        namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
        port: {{ .Values.service.main.ports.main.port }}
      
      # filters:
      #   - type: ExtensionRef
      #     extensionRef:
      #       group: traefik.io
      #       kind: Middleware
      #       name: chain-forwardauth

apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: minio-admin-creds
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  labels:
    homelab/backup-resource: "true"
spec:
  refreshPolicy: OnChange
  dataFrom:
  - sourceRef:
      generatorRef:
        apiVersion: generators.external-secrets.io/v1alpha1
        kind: ClusterGenerator
        name: "password"
  target:
    template:
      metadata:
        labels:
          homelab/backup-resource: "true"
      data:
        username: "minio"
        password: "{{ `{{ .password }}` }}"
      engineVersion: v2
